banner.provenance: The content-structure arc round thirteen, the tenth rules promotion batch under the R968 format: six records promoted mechanically from their spec JSONs into content/rules/dragon/ - issues 19 and 20 complete (dws the wish-spell doctrine opener, sdm the Origins 78 tournament opener, d19 the box closer, t20 the Polynesian pantheon opener, dst the 600-death campaign opener, d2c the box closer), 457 model items, every record parsed back and compared equal (the lossless proof). The batch sizing rides the raised ceiling (Curtiss, 2026-10-31): whole issue groups per round - this batch is 149970 bytes of Lua. Cumulative 56 of the walked 79-round Dragon set, 23 remaining.
